rationale:
PROG-003 collisions listed here are KNOWN intentional same-module-multiple-delivery-modes pairs. The teacher's pedagogical intent is 'completing any one of these files = the module is done.' Renaming the keys would split that intent into multiple separate XP grants which is incorrect.

Adding to this allowlist requires: (1) verification that all listed files teach/exercise the same conceptual module, (2) explicit reason field documenting the intent, (3) addedDate + addedBy for audit trail. The validator suppresses listed pairs from PROG-003 reports but emits PROG-003-DRIFT if the file set changes (loud signal that the intentional pair has been modified — re-verify intent before updating this file).

entries.reason: Same module — presentation teaches Cloud Computing Concepts (Network Essentials), tool is the Cloud Service Models Visualizer. Pedagogical intent: complete EITHER delivery mode (lecture or interactive visualizer) and the module counts as done. Splitting keys would double-credit students who do both.
Same module — presentation teaches Network Automation & Programmability concepts, tool is the Network Automation Visualizer. Same complete-either-mode intent as cloud-cloud above.
Same module — presentation teaches Network Automation & Programmability concepts (script-house framing), tool is the Network Automation Visualizer. Same complete-either-mode intent.

Same SIEM module — lab is 'SIEM Hands-On Lab', tool is 'SIEM Simulator'. Lab walks through scripted exercises; tool is an open-ended sandbox. Pedagogical intent: complete either delivery mode and the SIEM module is done.
